page.title: Messages
page.subtitle: {unread} unread conversations. Customer replies appear here.
page.emptyDescription: When a customer replies by SMS, the conversation appears here.

thread.title: Conversation
thread.placeholder: Write a message to the customer …
thread.empty: No messages in this conversation yet.
thread.quickHint: Uses the editable template for the event.

consent.title: Consent and opt-out
consent.description: SMS is only sent when the recipient has registered consent. A STOP reply opts the number out automatically.
consent.revoked: The number has been opted out.

settings.title: SMS and messaging
settings.description: The provider is selected with the SMS_PROVIDER environment variable. Edit templates and opt-out rules here.
settings.dryRunOn: Dry run – no messages leave the system.
settings.signatureOff: No signature configured. The webhook rejects deliveries.
settings.keywordsHint: One keyword per line, or comma separated.
settings.templatesHint: Placeholders must be in the list of allowed variables.
settings.errorForbidden: You do not have access to change SMS settings.
settings.errorInvalid: The fields are not valid. Check the template text and placeholders.

errors.invalid_contact: The contact has no phone number.
errors.noConsent: The contact has not consented to SMS.
errors.rate_limited: The monthly SMS limit has been reached.

reminders.title: Automated reminders
reminders.description: Send SMS or email before planned visits. Each rule covers one department, one channel and a number of hours before the visit.
reminders.quietHint: Quiet hours are local times (0–23). Leave both empty to send at any time. A window such as 22–07 crosses midnight.
reminders.noDepartments: No active departments. Create a department first.
reminders.noRules: No reminder rules have been created.
reminders.historyHint: Shows scheduled, sent and skipped reminders without message text or phone numbers.
reminders.noHistory: No reminders have been scheduled yet.
reminders.saved: The reminder rule has been saved.
reminders.conflict: A rule already exists for this department, channel and number of hours.

reasons.missing_customer: The work order has no customer
